Umpire Collapses After Being Struck by Ball During Hong Kong Sixes Match Between India and UAE

31 Oct 2026, 06:22 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: news.abplive.com

Image: Prateek Thakur

Key takeaways On-Field Incident Stops Play A cricket umpire collapsed on the ground after being struck on the head by a ball during a Hong Kong Sixes match between India and the UAE. According to reports circulating via social media and coverage of the event, the incident occurred

On-Field Incident Stops Play

A cricket umpire collapsed on the ground after being struck on the head by a ball during a Hong Kong Sixes match between India and the UAE. According to reports circulating via social media and coverage of the event, the incident occurred on the final delivery of the first over of the UAE innings, bowled by India's T Natarajan.

Video footage reviewed from the field shows UAE batter Khalid Shah connecting with a short delivery, sending the ball toward the square boundary for a six. The ball struck the umpire—who was positioned outside the boundary and appeared unaware of the incoming flight—causing him to fall immediately. Fellow officials and players, including Natarajan, rushed to assist the injured official.

Current Status and Unknowns

  • Confirmed Event: The umpire was struck on the head by a ball hit for six and subsequently collapsed.
  • Reported Footage: Videos of the incident have been widely shared across social media platforms.
  • Unknowns: As of the initial reports, no official statement regarding the umpire's medical condition or subsequent updates has been released by tournament organizers.

Match Context

The contest took place during the fast-paced Hong Kong Sixes tournament, a six-a-side competition sanctioned by the International Cricket Council and organized by Cricket Hong Kong, China.

In the match itself, India batted first and posted 94 runs in their allotted six overs, aided by an explosive 38 off 14 balls from Natarajan. In response, the UAE chased down the target with 10 balls to spare, securing a six-wicket victory driven by captain Khalid Shah's 52 runs and Ansh Tandon's 39 runs.

How to Verify

Readers seeking updates on the tournament or the official status of the umpire can consult:

  • Verified sports news outlets covering the Hong Kong Sixes tournament.
